description: JavaScript module defining outbound email fields handling, validation, and UI interactions for SuiteCRM.

methods.name: getValidationDefinition
methods.description: Retrieves validation definition for a specific form and field.

methods.name: configureValidation
methods.description: Configures validation rules for a form field.

methods.name: addRequiredIndicator
methods.description: Adds a visual indicator for required fields.

methods.name: removeRequiredIndicator
methods.description: Removes the visual indicator for required fields.

methods.name: getDefaultFieldGetter
methods.description: Returns default function to get field value.

methods.name: getDefaultFieldSetter
methods.description: Returns default function to set field value.

methods.name: setValue
methods.description: Sets the value of a specified field.

methods.name: getValue
methods.description: Retrieves the value of a specified field.

methods.name: getData
methods.description: Retrieves data attribute from a field.

methods.name: getField$
methods.description: Gets jQuery object for a field.

methods.name: getFieldCell$
methods.description: Gets jQuery object for a field's container cell.

methods.name: getFieldType
methods.description: Returns the data type of a field.

methods.name: getValueGetter
methods.description: Returns the appropriate getter function based on field type.

methods.name: getValueSetter
methods.description: Returns the appropriate setter function based on field type.

methods.name: setRequired
methods.description: Sets a field as required or optional, updating validation and UI.

methods.name: setRequiredIndicator
methods.description: Updates UI to show or hide required indicator.
